headline: Approved previous meeting minutes after one grammatical correction; no other decisions were recorded.
summary: Members approved the previous meeting minutes after one grammatical correction. They met in a confidential session with Attorney Sue Guer from 7:21 to 7:48 PM. No public comment, correspondence, reports, old business, or new business was recorded.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting minutes after one grammatical correction, by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes approved after one grammatical correction. Approved by Chair, Philip Kent, seconded by Ann Pari, followed by a unanimous vote.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Board of Ethics Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, August 11, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 The meeting was called to order at 7:11pm by the Chair, Philip Kent.  
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Roll taken: By B&C Clerk Porsche Edmundson,  
Present: Philip G. Kent, Chair, Ann M. Pari, Deirdre L. Moody, Ellen Rosenthal, Attorney 
Sue Guer, Porsche Edmundson. 
 
  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 Minutes approved after one grammatical correction. Approved by Chair, Philip Kent, 
seconded by Ann Pari, followed by a unanimous vote. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment to mention. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No new communications to speak of.  
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 Not required at this time, no updates currently from Attorney, Sue Guer. 
 Confidential session needed, motioned by Attorney, Sue Guer, and seconded by Chair, 
Phillip Kent. Everyone motioned in favor.  
They entered the confidential session at 7:21 and exited the confidential session at 7:48 
PM.   
  
7. REPORTS   
 No reports to speak of. 
8. OLD BUSINESS
No old business to speak of. 
 
 
  
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 No new business to speak of. 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 Motion to Adjourn at 7:51 PM by chair Kent, seconded by Ann Pari, all in favor. 
The meeting ended at 7:52 pm.  
Meeting minutes were taken by: B&C clerk Porsche Edmundson.
